Question: What is the average loss of each policy by policy number where loss is the sum of loss payment, loss reserve, expense payment, expense reserve amounts?
Generated Query:
SELECT
    p.Policy_Number,
    AVG(policy_loss.total_loss) AS average_loss
FROM (
    SELECT
        cc.Claim_Identifier,
        pcd.Policy_Identifier,
        SUM(COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0)) AS total_loss
    FROM Claim_Coverage cc
    JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
        ON cc.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date
       AND cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
    JOIN Claim_Amount ca
        ON cc.Claim_Identifier = ca.Claim_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Loss_Payment lp
        ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Loss_Reserve lr
        ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Expense_Payment ep
        ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Expense_Reserve er
        ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = er.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    WHERE lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
       OR lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
       OR ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
       OR er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY
        cc.Claim_Identifier,
        pcd.Policy_Identifier
) policy_loss
JOIN Policy p
    ON policy_loss.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
GROUP BY
    p.Policy_Number;

What is the premium amount of all policies by policy number?
Generated Query:
SELECT
    p.Policy_Number,
    SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS Premium_Amount
FROM Policy p
JOIN Policy_Amount pa
    ON pa.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN Premium pr
    ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
GROUP BY
    p.Policy_Number
ORDER BY
    p.Policy_Number;

What is the premium amount of all policies by policy number, coverage effective date and coverage expiration date

SELECT
    p.Policy_Number,
    pcd.Effective_Date AS Coverage_Effective_Date,
    pcd.Expiration_Date AS Coverage_Expiration_Date,
    SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS Premium_Amount
FROM Policy p
JOIN Policy_Amount pa
    ON pa.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN Premium pr
    ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
    ON pcd.Effective_Date = pa.Effective_Date
   AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pa.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
GROUP BY
    p.Policy_Number,
    pcd.Effective_Date,
    pcd.Expiration_Date
ORDER BY
    p.Policy_Number,
    pcd.Effective_Date,
    pcd.Expiration_Date;
